{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_patients = trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check the list of duplicate patient IDs
duplicate_ids = trial_df[trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]['patient_id'].unique()

# Count how many times each duplicate ID appears
duplicate_counts = trial_df['patient_id'].value_counts().loc[duplicate_ids]

# Print results
duplicate_patients, duplicate_ids, duplicate_counts"}
